hero.headline: Cooling the Minds of Machines
hero.subheadline: Our specialized cooling architecture is designed to handle 40kW racks while maintaining a target PUE of 1.3-1.5 in a tropical climate.

sections.title: Optimized Airflow for Maximum Performance
sections.body: Modern AI hardware operates at extreme thermal thresholds. A single GPU rack can generate as much heat as a small apartment building. To manage this, Kenya AI Compute utilizes a rigid Hot Aisle/Cold Aisle containment strategy within our modular units. By physically separating the chilled air from the heated exhaust, we eliminate air mixing and significantly reduce the workload on our precision cooling units (CRACs). We leverage Kenya's low-humidity climate to utilize air-side economizers, bringing in filtered outside air when temperatures are optimal. This 'Free Cooling' approach is the primary reason we can achieve a PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) that rivals the best data centers in the world. For our 1MW Phase 2 expansion, we are also preparing liquid cooling loops for ultra-high density clusters, ensuring our facility remains future-proof as GPU wattages continue to rise. sections.title: Thermal Control Systems
items: Containment: Rigid hot/cold aisle separation for 0% air bypass.
Economizers: Intelligent outside air usage to reduce compressor cycles.
Redundancy: N+1 cooling units per module to ensure continuous heat rejection.
Sensors: Real-time thermal mapping using thousands of IoT sensors.
Filtration: G4/F7 grade air filtration to prevent dust accumulation on GPUs.
